about: Where each input in PTR's window goes while Minecraft is the player. Minecraft's own keybinds apply to everything forwarded (yours, copied from your 26.3 instance).

columns.verified: Evidence from a real run, or 'no'

rows.input: every key except Esc, O and G
rows.when: in a level, PTR focused, no PTR menu
rows.how: SDL scancode press/release into Minecraft's KeyboardHandler (WASD, space, shift, E, Q, 1-9, T, F5...)
rows.verified: 2026-10-09: walking, hotbar switching seen in play

rows.how: PTR's camera turns at once with Minecraft's sensitivity formula; Minecraft's player follows the published yaw/pitch

rows.when: a Minecraft screen is open (inventory, chat, menus)
rows.how: cursor in overlay pixels; PTR's own cursor lock is overridden (GameManager.SetCursorAppropriate) so the OS cursor is free and visible
PTR's own pause menu; Minecraft holds still while it's open
PTR's use: press buttons, take Beneath items/upgrades, shop pickups (PTR weapons are dropped again)
Minecraft's camera modes: first person (no body), behind, in front; PTR's camera follows with Minecraft's zoom collision and draws Minecraft's player model
everything held is released in Minecraft
